第247章  狐影诉真相神虎生异心（第1页）
九翅神虎皇子盘膝而坐，周身虎焰忽明忽暗。
胸口一道深可见骨的剑伤还在渗着金色的妖血，那是林婉儿留下的。
人族四英虽败，却也拼得妖族七位皇子重伤，他便是其中之一。
“这样可不行，好几千人不睡觉，在等着咱们帮他们开门呢！”格瑞夫身上的汗水和河水混在了一起，慢慢往地上流，他在水底用力拉动那个铁栏门差不多有三十次，但是它却没有任何松动的痕迹。
一道道奔着要害过来的枪气被粉碎了，但是更多的却在叶天鸿的身体留下一道道伤口，鲜血淋漓。
但是现在，苏易身上的机密，他竟然一点也看不透，那这个苏易，也绝对不是简单之人，要是真的能够得到他的帮助，找到了自己这重瞳的破点，那么，自己哪里能够不欣喜呢。
“你、你不是应该已经……”杨冲本想仔细看看这个仿佛宇宙飞船当中截出的一块地方，在见到最后一人，大惊失色。
“你别想那么多了，无论如何你都得去，除非你现在就想死，不过你放心，有我在，你还死不了。”李天通说道。
而菲德也随之游了出来，他头上也沾满了黑色的垃圾残渣，只是和他的黑发一比，根本不算黑。
“强巴、次仁、占堆！你们好好保护僧王！”桑东大吼一声，二话不说，手提十字金刚杵杀向吴敌，二人相互纠缠，渐渐消失在众人眼前。
“韦伯斯特大公让我亲自送沃尔特王子归来，同时也让我见证你的婚礼，保证事态的正确进展。”中年男人说话的语气阴阳怪气，每说一个字，嘴角边上的八字胡便会轻轻地动一动。
流淌了一地的鬼气之水当中诞生出一朵朵灰败的莲花，每一朵莲花都像是一个正在释放自身立场的精英级四转者，一道道扭曲随后在这一片汪洋当中壮大的立场，就像是大山般不断的朝着杨冲压迫。
唐斩只觉手臂一麻，倒退了数步，林行天并没有低估对手，一分之下，攻势滞住片刻，迅即重组，流星剑式如惊涛骇浪般重重掩杀而出。
倏尔，众神山颠，那伟岸的身影睁开了双眼，虚空生电，九天起雷鸣。足足七对黄金神翅在背后展开。这一刻遮天蔽日。神辉无尽，若一道道巨瀑垂落下来。
“好了，我也已经玩腻了，就了结你们吧。”狩矢说着，便伸出双手，随后，一股旋风缠绕在手上。
因为愤怒，无数的涅盘之火，在他的身上熊熊燃烧起来，最后喷薄向天，形成一条壮观无比的涅盘火焰柱。
净界章的封印还未完全巩固，静灵庭现在根本调不出战力去对付巴温特，而一旦被巴温特得到净界章，那后果将是不堪设想。

卫正相何尝不懂卫父言中的深意，只可惜以他的秉性，想要做到卫父所说的那样，怕是不rongyi。
如果换成梦境中的大萝莉使出“驻龙一剑”也会有奇效，但岳阳刚刚领悟出来，威力尚有太多不足，这招反袭虽然成功，可是无效。
而且洛雅话音刚落，背后的四只羽翼，忽的向外一张。霎时间一股金风向周围迅猛扩散，将周遭方圆百丈的尘土，一扫而空。

The nine-winged divine tiger prince sat cross-legged, and the tiger flames around him flickered on and off.
A bone-deep sword wound on the chest was still seeping with golden demon blood, which was left by Lin Wan'er.
Although the four heroes of the human race were defeated, they still managed to injure seven princes of the demon race, and he was one of them.
"This won't work. Thousands of people are not sleeping, waiting for us to open the door for them!" The sweat on Greif's body mixed with the river water and slowly flowed to the ground. He pulled the iron gate under the water almost thirty times, but there was no sign of it loosening.
The gun Qi that rushed towards the vital point was shattered, but more of them left wounds on Ye Tianhong's body, dripping with blood.
But now, he couldn't see through the secrets of Su Yi at all. Then this Su Yi was definitely not a simple person. If he could really get his help and find the breaking point of his double pupils, then how could he not be happy?
"You, shouldn't you have..." Yang Chong wanted to take a closer look at this place that seemed to be cut out of a spaceship, but when he saw the last person, he was shocked.
"Don't think so much. You have to go no matter what, unless you want to die now. But don't worry, you won't die as long as I'm here." Li Tiantong said.
Feide also swam out. His head was also covered with black garbage residue, but compared with his black hair, it was not black at all.
"Jiangpa, Tsering, Zhandui! Protect the monk king!" Sang Dong roared. Without saying a word, he carried the cross vajra pestle and killed Wu's enemy. The two entangled each other and gradually disappeared from everyone's eyes.
"Grand Duke Webster asked me to personally send Prince Walter back, and also asked me to witness your wedding to ensure the correct progress of the situation." The middle-aged man spoke in a sinister tone, and with every word he spoke, the mustache at the corner of his mouth would move slightly.
A bunch of gray lotuses were born from the ghostly water flowing all over the ground. Each lotus looked like an elite fourth-turner who was releasing his stance. The stances that twisted and then grew in this vast ocean were constantly pressing towards Yang Chong like a mountain.
Tang Zhan felt his arm go numb and took a few steps back. Lin Xingtian did not underestimate his opponent. After a point, his offensive stalled for a moment, then quickly regrouped, and the Meteor Sword Style was like a turbulent wave.
Suddenly, on the top of the Gods Mountain, the majestic figure opened his eyes, the void was electrified, and thunder began in the sky. A full seven pairs of golden divine wings spread out behind his back. At this moment, the sky is blocked out. The divine brilliance is endless, like huge waterfalls falling down.
"Okay, I'm tired of playing, so I'll finish you off." Kariya said, then stretched out his hands, and then a whirlwind wrapped around his hands.
Because of his anger, countless Nirvana fires burned blazingly on his body, and finally erupted into the sky, forming a spectacular pillar of Nirvana flames.
The seal of the Pure World Seal has not yet been fully consolidated, and Jinglingting cannot mobilize its combat power to deal with Bawent. Once Bawent obtains the Pure World Seal, the consequences will be disastrous.
Wei Zhengxiang did not understand the profound meaning of Wei's father's words. Unfortunately, given his nature, it would be unreasonable to want to do what Wei's father said.
If the big Lolita in the dream used the "Dragon Sword", it would be miraculous, but Yue Yang just realized that the power was still too weak. Although this counterattack was successful, it was ineffective.
And as soon as Luo Ya finished speaking, the four wings on her back suddenly spread outward. A burst of gold in an instantThe wind spread rapidly to the surrounding area, sweeping away the dust in a radius of a hundred feet.
